usage.technical_labels: IBM Plex Mono Medium (500) 12px - 14px uppercase, tracking-[0.04em]

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure tight tracking (tracking-tight) on headings above 32px. Technical labels MUST use IBM Plex Mono for components like 'GB-229', '30x50 FT', 'STAGE 04'.

rules: Highlight Yellow (#FFFF00) NEVER used as a page background, and NEVER carries body text.
Signal Green (#93C526) used for ALL primary CTAs, pins, and specific accents.
Ink Black (#000000) is for TEXT ONLY. NEVER use black button fills.
NEVER put green text on yellow or yellow on green.

grids_and_spacing.shadows: No heavy shadows. Apply soft ambient shadow on hover ONLY (hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-black/5).

motion.section_reveal: Fade + 12px rise (translate-y-3), 400ms ease-out on scroll using framer-motion.
motion.marquee: Testimonials use 60s loop, opposite directions for two rows, pause on hover (use react-fast-marquee).

layouts.hero_section: 60/40 Split. Left (60%): Soft Yellow Wash (#FFFCE6) panel with mono label ('GB · 2026 · LUCKNOW'), display headline 'Your home. Built once. Built right.', supporting line, Signal Green pill CTA 'Start Your Project →', ghost CTA 'Try the Cost Calculator', micro-trust line. Right (40%): Compact live cost calculator card (City dropdown, Plot Area input, unit toggle → live cost output).
layouts.why_choose: 12-pillar grid. Clean minimal cards with hairline Divider Grey borders.
layouts.mobile_sticky_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (z-50) split 50/50: 'Call Now' (Signal Green bg, White/Black text) + 'WhatsApp' (Highlight Yellow bg, Ink Black text).
layouts.pricing_tiers: 3 tiers. Middle tier visually raised with a Signal Green border.

sections_architecture: 05 Live Projects Map (fallback: filterable project card grid)
07 Full 3-step Cost Calculator (inputs → donut + timeline bar chart → resource table with Basic/Medium/Premium quality radios → Print/Share/Book actions)
13 Pricing (3 tiers, middle raised with green border)
18 Final CTA + consultation form on soft yellow

components.nav: Sticky top nav. MUST use solid white or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90) background. NO fully transparent headers.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary/secondary actions. Green bg for primary. Ghost/outline for secondary.
components.cards: 16px radius, 1px Divider Grey border, no default shadow, soft hover shadow.
components.cost_calculator_ui: Inputs (Shadcn Select for City, Input for area) → Visuals (Recharts Donut for category split, Timeline bar chart) → Table (Shadcn Table for resources) → Quality Tiers (Shadcn RadioGroup for Basic/Medium/Premium).

media_and_charts.images: NO STOCK PHOTOS. Use neutral grey placeholder blocks (bg-[#E9E9E6]) with centered IBM Plex Mono text labeled 'IMG-01', 'IMG-02', etc.
media_and_charts.charts: Use Recharts. Color scale for charts MUST be a gradient/palette ranging from Signal Green to Highlight Yellow. Avoid Ink Black in chart fills to maintain readability.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly adhere to the LOCKED color palette and typography rules. The combination of Ink Black, Signal Green, and Highlight Yellow is distinctive; use white/wash spaces generously to prevent it from feeling garish.
Voice constraint: Use clear Hindi+English, short sentences, specific numbers, and NO superlatives. Keep the tagline: 'Kyu ki ghar banata hai ek baar.'
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Prioritize left-alignment for dense content, forms, and technical metrics.
Create depth using the 1px #E9E9E6 border and subtle hover shadows, NOT heavy default shadows.
Implement `data-testid` on ALL interactive and key informational elements (e.g., `data-testid='hero-calculator-city-dropdown'`).
Write JavaScript (.jsx) files for React, NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Use Shadcn UI primitive components heavily customized to match the 8px/16px radii constraints.
Always define both hover and active states (active:scale-[0.98] on buttons).
No completely transparent backgrounds on overlays, sticky navs, or headers.
All imagery must be constructed with structural `div` blocks acting as placeholders labeled via the IMG-NN code system.
